note: Planted defect: JSON.parse of the user config has no error handling, but the spec requires a corrupt file to fall back to defaults with a warning. The unhandled error path is in lib/settings.js only.
question: Review this change against its spec and report your findings.

fixture.spec:
## WHAT
`loadSettings()` reads `~/.toolrc.json` and merges it over the defaults.

## DONE
- [ ] a missing file yields the defaults
- [ ] a file that is not valid JSON yields the defaults and prints one warning to stderr
- [ ] known keys override defaults; unknown keys are ignored
